description: The International Soundscape Database contains the results of a series of soundscape assessment campaigns carried out across Europe and China.

dataset_name: Affective Responses to Augmented Urban Soundscapes (ARAUS)
description: ARAUS is a large‐scale benchmark dataset comprising 25,440 unique subjective responses to 30‐second audio-visual stimuli of augmented urban soundscapes. The dataset is organized as a five-fold cross-validation set plus an independent test set, and was collected in accordance with ISO/TS 12913-2:2018.
ATHUS is a dataset of audio recordings of ambient urban sounds, which has been annotated in terms of the corresponding perceived soundscape quality.
annotation_framework: Soundscape perception quality in range of 1 to 5 (level of “pleasantness”)

description: The IADS-2 dataset is a standardised collection of 167 six-second natural sounds widely used in emotional research
An expanded version of the International Affective Digitized Sounds (IADS-E), an extensive auditory stimulus collection designed to facilitate research on emotional and affective responses to sound.
The Emo-soundscapes dataset contains 1,213 soundscapes, each 6 seconds long, generated using individual audio clips from Freesound with affective labels.

The University of Applied Sciences D¨ usseldorf dataset (HSDD) is an extensive crowdsourced dataset of in-situ evaluated indoor soundscapes of private dwellings, containing binaural recordings, subjective soundscape ratings, and rich situational and person-related variables collected via Experience Sampling Method.
acoustic_measuring_instrument: Low self-noise binaural recording device; post-processed with HEAD acoustics Artemis

description: The Deep Learning Techniques for noise Annoyance detection (DeLTA) dataset comprises 2,980 15-second binaural audio recordings collected in urban public spaces across London, Venice, Granada, and Groningen (derived from the International Soundscape Database).
acoustic_measuring_instrument: Sound Level Meter and binaural recorder

description: The Soundscape Assessment in Transport-related Public spaces (SATP) dataset contains short binaural and audiovisual recordings collected in transport-related urban public spaces with associated ISO 12913 soundscape ratings.
Mixed-reality soundscape dataset combining in-situ urban traffic sounds with visual holograms of natural sound sources, evaluated for overall soundscape quality and preference.
annotation_framework: Overall Soundscape Quality (OSQ) and soundscape preference (11-point scales)

description: Dataset to study mood recovery effects of natural vs. anthropogenic sounds, using 3-min clips rated by university students before and after a stressor.
annotation_framework: Self-reported mood scales (e.g., positive and negative affect)

description: Audiovisual urban scenes captured with ambisonics and 360° video, annotated with perceptual attributes via sorting tasks and interviews.
annotation_framework: Perceptual attribute sorting and interviews (qualitative descriptors)

description: VR-based immersive dataset of 360° audiovisual recordings from urban public open spaces, annotated for soundscape classification and perceptual attributes.
annotation_framework: Soundscape classification (e.g., calm, exciting) and perceptual ratings

description: Spatiotemporal dataset of urban audiovisual recordings in Mumbai annotated using ISO-based perceptual labels to predict human perception in an urban setting.
Audiovisual urban recordings with 360° video and ambisonic audio, evaluated for the perceived affective qualities of urban soundscapes via online and VR experiments.
acoustic_measuring_instrument: Ambisonic microphone and sound level meter

description: Indoor soundscape dataset with 20 one-minute loudspeaker-reproduced scenarios combining outdoor façade noise and indoor sounds, assessed with a 97-item perceptual questionnaire in a mock-up living room.
Affective annotation of audio clips from IADS-E and short film fragments using the EmojiGrid to provide rich valence–arousal responses.
Dataset of 200 natural auditory scenes evaluated for global properties such as openness, naturalness, transience, and navigability.
Field-recorded dataset of natural protected areas in the Italian Alps, assessed via ISO 12913 questionnaires and acoustic analysis to characterise quiet areas.

The Lion City Soundscapes (LCS) dataset contains over 24 hours of full-length urban soundscape recordings collected at 62 locations in Singapore, together with one-minute perceptually diverse excerpts generated using a modified partitioning around medoids (PAM) algorithm guided by Pleasantness–Eventfulness predictions.
acoustic_measuring_instrument: GRAS 146AE Free-field Microphone + HEAD Acoustics SQobold (Class 1)
